decision_needed: Do we have written permission (or a licence) to store, publish and derive aggregates from NFL.com data?
why_it_blocks: Every downstream table, model feature and published row is derived from NFL.com data. If the right is not cleared, expanding, automating or commercialising that use is not authorised.
current_state: No permission or licence is recorded in this repository (Flag F16). The Week 10 snapshot is already published.
answer_required: A named rightsholder response in writing: permitted fields, retention, publication, derived aggregates, and model use.
what_it_unblocks: S02, S04, S07; the whole validation chain (D03, D07); any expansion of the injury dataset.

decision_needed: Which licensed market (odds) feed will be used, and on what terms?
why_it_blocks: A line cannot be compared with the market, graded, or scored for closing-line value without a timestamped, permitted price source. Correlation of legs is not measurable without offered prices.
current_state: No authorised odds feed or price history in this repository (Flag F07). NFL Support states its widgets show partner-supplied odds; that is not a feed grant.
answer_required: Provider name, contract terms, historical depth, market/settlement definitions, timestamp granularity, permitted derived use.
what_it_unblocks: S03, line comparison, closing-line value, grading, gate G2 and G4, parlay and prop pricing.
status: Open - blocks any line or price value

decision_needed: Do we have rights-cleared historical results, box scores and player participation?
why_it_blocks: Validation, correlation and out-of-sample skill testing all need settled historical outcomes aligned to a pregame cutoff. Without history there is no sample to test.
current_state: No historical results or player-stat archive is imported (Flag F08). Only the Week 10 injury snapshot and a headline list exist.
answer_required: Archive access terms plus a documented, reproducible point-in-time record of outcomes and participation.
what_it_unblocks: S02, every validation gate, correlation values (Q11), replacement-impact analysis.

decision_needed: What is the official source of starter / 2nd / 3rd / 4th string order?
why_it_blocks: The brief asks which backups replace starters. String rank cannot be inferred from roster order or from an injury label, so replacement analysis has no verified input.
current_state: No official NFL depth chart located. The conventional team depth-chart URL returns a 404 and the roster page shows position and status only (Flag F06).
answer_required: A dated team-issued chart or licensed primary feed, plus the capture date for each chart version.
what_it_unblocks: S01, starter-vs-backup deficiency rows, position-level exposure on offense and defense.
status: Open - rank fields stay blank and flagged

decision_needed: How much does a replacement actually play, and how is that measured?
why_it_blocks: Naming a backup is not the same as measuring the effect of losing a starter. Snap share and participation are needed before any impact claim.
current_state: No snap-count or participation feed is connected. Replacement-impact fields are blank.
answer_required: An official or licensed participation source with per-game snap counts and permitted derived use.
what_it_unblocks: Replacement-impact scoring, unit-level deficiency weighting, prop role baselines.

decision_needed: What exact market and settlement definitions govern each bet family?
why_it_blocks: A forecast cannot be graded against a market whose push, void, tie and suspension rules are undefined. Rule era also changes what counts as the same market across seasons.
current_state: Rulebook located; no sportsbook settlement rules or market definitions are licensed (source verification note for SRC-07).
answer_required: Written settlement rules per market family, plus the tied/push handling used in evaluation.
what_it_unblocks: Grading, gate alignment, any single-bet or parlay result.

decision_needed: What statistical plan is pre-registered before any test is run?
why_it_blocks: Without a pre-registered plan, any threshold or 'pass' selected after seeing results is post-hoc. NIST guidance supports separating model selection, fitting and validation, and warns about repeated comparisons.
current_state: Numeric cutoffs are deliberately blank and unapproved (Flag F17). No sample size, interval method or multiple-comparison procedure is approved.
answer_required: A signed-off plan fixing the event set, baseline, evaluation window, uncertainty method and pass rule before data is examined.
what_it_unblocks: S08, S09, gate G0-G8 completion, the leaderboard ranking rule.

decision_needed: What correlation quantity is being measured, and on what paired data?
why_it_blocks: 'Correlation' can mean leg dependence, forecast agreement, or co-movement of returns. Pairwise correlation alone does not determine joint-tail probability for a parlay or prop combo.
current_state: Nine correlation values are now computed from the official 2026 results, with confidence intervals, p-values and the pairing used (see the Correlations page). Still blank: correlations between player-prop outcomes and between prop legs, because no prop outcome or price data exists in this repository (F31).
answer_required: A chosen quantity, a paired aligned dataset, and a stated uncertainty method that preserves game/week clustering.
what_it_unblocks: Same-game prop combos, cross-game parlay joint probability, gate G5.
status: Partially resolved - game-level correlations computed; prop-level correlations stay blank (F31)

decision_needed: Is the intended product lawful for the actual audience and each target jurisdiction?
why_it_blocks: Rewards and wagering features carry jurisdiction-specific legal exposure. Official Japanese guidance addresses online sports betting from Japan and does not decide an unspecified skill contest or another jurisdiction.
current_state: Official government guidance recorded as a risk reference; no legal opinion obtained (Flag F09).
answer_required: Qualified advice on the exact mechanics, audience location, reward treatment and each target jurisdiction.
what_it_unblocks: S10, any reward, referral or real-money feature, leaderboard prize design (R05).

decision_needed: What exactly is rewarded, and how is skill separated from variance?
why_it_blocks: A reward attached to a ranking that has not separated skill from luck would pay for noise. The brief asks to remove luck, which cannot be done by deleting variance - only by uncertainty-aware, pre-registered, out-of-sample evaluation.
current_state: No reward is defined. Leaderboard is an explicit empty state (R05).
answer_required: Reward definition, eligibility, entry terms, dispute process and the validated ranking rule from D07 and D08.
what_it_unblocks: S09 completion, any leaderboard rank, any prize.
status: Open - no rank or reward published
